title: Elux Cyberover 6k Pineapple Ice Prefilled Pod Vape Kit
description: The Elux Cyberover 6K Prefilled Pod Vape Kit in Pineapple Ice flavour combines cutting-edge design, convenience, and tropical indulgence. With its compact and lightweight construction, this device is the perfect choice for vapers who value portability and premium performance. The Cyberover 6K is powered by an 850mAh rechargeable battery, capable of delivering up to 6000 puffs per device. USB-C fast charging ensures quick and convenient recharges, while the replaceable battery design adds an eco-conscious touch, allowing for safe recycling and replacement as needed. This kit features a 2ml prefilled pod and an additional 10ml refill container, equipped with advanced mesh coil technology optimised for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping. Preloaded with Elux’s Pineapple Ice flavour, this kit delivers the juicy tang of ripe pineapple paired with an icy menthol kick for a bold and refreshing vape. With its leak-resistant design, vibrant flavour profiles, and ease of use, the Elux Cyberover 6K Prefilled Pod Vape Kit is a fantastic option for vapers seeking a reliable, flavour-rich device. How to Use the Elux Cyberover 6K Pod Vape Kit: 1. Open the Cap: Press down and twist the cap counter clockwise to unlock it. Do not remove the rubber cover. 2. Remove the Silicone Bar: Gently pull out the silicone bar to prepare the device for refilling. 3. Insert the Refill Container: Align and slide the refill container into the designated opening on the device. 4. Refill the Pod: Turn the device upside down and hold it in this position for 10 seconds to allow the pod to refill from the e-liquid container. 5. Start Vaping: Once refilled, return the device to its upright position and enjoy a satisfying vaping experience.
